title: Oman Air Celebrates National Day with up to 20% off Fares: Fly to 40+ Destinations From Just OMR 29
text:
Oman Air Celebrates National Day with up to 20% off Fares: Fly to 40+ Destinations From Just OMR 29
Oman Air has launched a special Global Sale to mark Oman’s National Day, offering travellers up to 20% off Business and Economy Class seats across its network. Running until 30 November 2025, the promotion provides the perfect opportunity to discover a new destination or revisit a favourite one.
With a choice of more than 40 destinations across Europe, the Middle East, Far East, Africa, GCC and the Indian Subcontinent, guests can take advantage of exceptional value and award-winning service. Those wanting to get the best out of their budget can enjoy Economy Class fares starting from just OMR 29, while those seeking a more premium experience can grab a Business Class bargain from just OMR 128.
The sale includes one-way and return fares and is valid for travel from 15 January to 31 March 2026. Please note that the offer does not include domestic flights, interline flights, or codeshare partners. Other terms and conditions also apply.
Bookings can be made through Oman Air’s website or mobile app.
Background Information
Oman Air
Oman Air is the flagship carrier of the Sultanate of Oman and an Official 4 Star Airline (Skytrax 2011). Founded in 1993, the airline has since witnessed massive growth and has played a major role in making Muscat an important traffic hub in the Middle East, supporting the commercial, industrial and tourism sectors.
The airline currently operates direct international flights from Muscat to Abu Dhabi, Bahrain, Doha, Dubai, Jeddah, Riyadh, Dammam, Madina, and Kuwait, in the Gulf region, as well as Cairo, Amman, Tehran, Mashhad, Najaf, Zanzibar and Dar Es Salaam within the wider Middle East/Africa region.
